notes: Two fixes from real counter use. (1) The Pictures counter now waits until every picture source has finished (phone icons, conversions, the faces pack) and then prints its two lines exactly once, computed from what is actually on screen -- the number can no longer change mid-scan. (2) Nothing renders blank any more: an app with no picture of its own and no maker logo now wears a neutral APP chip, and it is counted on the badge line with the maker logos, never as a picture.
